summary: Major B42 release — crafting overhaul, item system rewrite, mod structure changes. Note: ISInventoryPane/ISInventoryPaneContextMenu still exist in B42.

changes.description: Mod has Lua files but no common/ or 42/ folder. PZ B42 may not recognize the mod at all without this layout (verified empirically on 42.17).
Mod declares versionMin but has no 42/ folder. Without 42/media/lua/... layout, PZ B42 (verified on 42.17) does not recognize the mod and it will not appear in the in-game Mods menu.
mod.info must declare versionMin for B42 compatibility. Mods using the older pzversion field are filtered out as B41-only and will not appear in the in-game Mods menu (verified empirically on 42.17).
mod.info missing from 42/ folder. PZ B42 requires mod.info in BOTH the root AND 42/ folder. Without 42/mod.info, the mod will not appear in the in-game Mods menu (verified empirically on 42.17).
ISToolTipInv may be changed/removed in B42
changes.context: Tooltip system updated with new inventory

changes.description: ISCraftingUI removed — crafting system completely overhauled in B42
changes.context: B42 crafting system is entirely new

changes.description: Old recipe Lua API removed — B42 uses new crafting system

changes.description: B41 ModOptions implementation replaced with native ModOptions API
changes.context: B42 has a native ModOptions API — see https://pzwiki.net/wiki/ModOptions

changes.description: B42 replaced 'Type = Food' with 'ItemType = base:food' — old syntax may still load but is not guaranteed
changes.context: B42 game scripts use 'ItemType = base:food' and 'DisplayCategory = Food' — vanilla no longer uses 'Type = Food'
